title: Herrera attends Greer's CE5 sessions

tellings.quote: Well, I think that's what Dr. Greer's whole C5 initiative is all about which I've personally attended a few of them.

plain: Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a huge UFO in the Indonesian jungle, says he has personally attended a few CE5 sessions run by Dr. Steven Greer, a UFO campaigner. CE5 is Greer's practice of groups trying to invite contact with beings from elsewhere, and Herrera brings it up while saying this is what that effort is all about.
